error[ZBX-E0609]: the listener could not be handed on to --listen-send
  cause  sending the listener failed: broken pipe (EPIPE)
  fix    keep the other end of the socket open until zbx has sent the listener
  more   zbx explain E0609 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0609.html
